title: Generative Remove on the removal benchmark
note: Thirteen CC0 photos for Lightroom's Generative Remove: six real ones and seven composites, each an object pasted onto a clean photo, which comes too as its -truth file to export unedited. Each step's picture outlines what to remove in red. RM-20 and RM-21 score the exports against Redlamp's fills (research/benchmarks/removal.json); the photos, the composites and the pictures are made by research/prototypes/generative/make_removal_composites.py and the prototype CLI into build/benchmarks/removal/.

steps.title: Share the 20 photos to Lightroom Classic
steps.detail: Thirteen photos to remove something from, and seven -truth files, which stay as they are.

steps.title: Choose the Remove tool with Generative AI
steps.detail: Develop › Remove (Q). Mode: Remove. Tick Use Generative AI. Leave everything else as it is.

steps.title: Photo 1, d7500-car: brush over the car
steps.detail: Brush over all of the area outlined in red, the car and its shadow, in one stroke if you can. Keep the first variation Lightroom shows.

steps.title: Photo 2, r6m2-van: brush over the van
steps.detail: Brush over all of the area outlined in red, the van and its shadow. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 3, 7d2-ducks: brush over the four ducks
steps.detail: Brush over all four outlined areas, each duck with its reflection, one stroke each, keeping the first variation of each.

steps.title: Photo 4, s22-ferry: brush over the ferry
steps.detail: Brush over all of the area outlined in red, the ferry with its mast and flag. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 5, 80d-trunk: brush over the trunk
steps.detail: Brush over the outlined part of the trunk, from the ground up to where the outline ends; the branches above stay. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 6, g95d-leaves: brush over the two leaves
steps.detail: Brush over the two large leaves outlined in red at the bottom. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 7, composite-paving: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 8, composite-grass: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 9, composite-wall: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 10, composite-windows: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 11, composite-facade: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 12, composite-railing: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Photo 13, composite-water: brush over the object
steps.detail: Brush over all of the red object outlined in red. Keep the first variation.

steps.title: Leave the seven -truth files unedited
steps.detail: No edits at all on the files ending in -truth: they show Lightroom's own rendering of each composite without its object.

steps.title: Export all 20
steps.detail: Select all 20. File › Export: Image Format TIFF, Bit Depth 16 bits/component, Color Space sRGB, Resize to Fit off, Output Sharpening off, Rename To off so the original file names are kept.

steps.title: Share the exports back
steps.detail: Share the 20 TIFFs to Redlamp Bench. They pair with their photos by file name.
